sys_script.description: Before-insert and before-update on x_casemgmt_case_party: refuses any write that would store an empty mandatory case/party_type/role_label, a `case` reference that does not resolve to a live x_casemgmt_case row, an unrecognised party_type, or a person/organization pair that violates the exactly-one-of invariant AAP Section 0.5.7 states through its two Conditional rows. Closes QA finding F15 for the party table, which carried NO business rule at all - the whole polymorphic contract lived in the UI Policy, which runs in the form engine only. Measured before this rule: party_type=Person with no person returned 201; BOTH person and organization returned 201 (a row that is simultaneously a Person party and an Organization party, breaking the invariant the single-table collapse of ArkCase acm_person_assoc + acm_person_org_assoc rests on per Section 0.1.1); neither set and no party_type returned 201. The discriminator-to-column mapping is declared once as data in PARTY_TYPE_FIELDS, so all four downstream decisions derive from it. One case NORMALISES rather than refuses: when this write itself CHANGED party_type and the newly applicable reference is populated, the now-inapplicable one is cleared and logged via gs.info, because the UI Policy hides that field without clearing it and the classic form POSTs the hidden, non-disabled input verbatim - measured on the wire - so refusing would make a legitimate Organization-to-Person conversion impossible through the only internal UI AAP Section 0.4.4 provides, and the caller could not comply because the field is off their screen. An INSERT carrying both references, and an UPDATE that sets the wrong reference without touching party_type, are both still refused, so the stored row satisfies the exactly-one-of invariant on every path. The parent is resolved with plain GlideRecord, not GlideRecordSecure, so the rule tests EXISTENCE only and leaves authorization to the scoped ACLs of Section 0.5.6. Order=100; returns early on current.isActionAborted(); reproduces none of the four verbatim messages Section 0.7.4 fixes. Does not fire on delete, so the cascade rule on the case reference and the manager Delete grant are both untouched. Contains zero gs.eventQueue() calls per the email-disabled constraint.
sys_script.name: x_casemgmt_validate_case_party_integrity
